highlights: Saving seed now lands you on the Saved Seeds page, where the lot you just started is sitting with its clock running. Before this it dropped you on the packet's own page, and the queue — the only place that warns you a ferment has gone too long — was never shown
Inventory has a "Saved seeds" chip in the header now, so the page is reachable from where your seed actually lives instead of only from a row inside the More menu
The packet picker can filter by crop. Your two biggest crops sit on the row and the rest are one tap away — and it finds packets whose names never mention the crop, which typing the crop name cannot
